plain: To raise or collect a tax or fine by authority.

more.text: The act of collecting men for military, or other public service, as by enlistment, enrollment or other means.
The act of collecting money for public use by tax or other imposition.

example.quote: The same instrument, says another, obliges each province to levy certain contributions; but this article never could, and probably never will, be executed; because the inland provinces, who have little commerce, cannot pay an equal quota.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 20 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 11, 1787
